text:
Anya: quick heads-up — ACME wants a 6-week on‑prem POC. They're asking for the platform fee to be waived for the POC and for support to be S1 (standard SLA). No annual commit right now; they're asking for a short evaluation without committing. Any flexibility from deal desk?

Sanjay: tech note — on‑prem/VPC includes a private control plane + automated build artifacts for the customer. Platform fee mostly covers the private control plane and ops runbook. Waiving completely has nontrivial run-costs.

Marc: @Anya thanks. Need baseline numbers before I can sign off. What are they asking for exactly (monthly platform fee amount + expected GPU footprint)?

Anya: they're expecting a modest footprint — single node for the POC (1x A100 equivalence). Platform fee quoted in the deal is $6k/mo for private control plane + S1 support. POC runs 6 weeks. Customer asks for full waiver for POC.

Lucy: finance note — typical discount bands: up to 25% pref-approved; anything >25% needs VP sales sign-off and must be tied to a firm commit/ARR. Waiving 100% for >1 month is outside standard.

Marc: suggested structured options we can offer to ACME (short bullets to present):
- Option 1: Full POC waiver for up to 6 weeks if customer signs 12‑month reserved capacity commit >= $150k ARR (or equivalent reserved GPU commit).
- Option 2: 50% platform fee credit for the 2nd and 3rd month of production, applied as a billing credit across the first 12 months (no upfront waive). No long-term commit required, but requires PO for first 3 months.
- Option 3: No waiver; offer engineering onboarding credit (one‑time $6k credit) + S1 included for first 3 months.

Emma: legal — any special waiver needs an addendum to the MSA with a clear expiration and recoup clause. If we offer credits that amortize over 12 months, include an early-termination recoup schedule (pro rata). Also need to call out KMS/data residency obligations for on‑prem.

cthomas_acme: thanks, team. Priority for us: try before we commit long term. KMS integration and having the platform fee waived during evaluation are both important. If waiver isn't possible, a simple 3‑month credit that doesn't require a full 12mo commit would work too. Also: can you confirm if KMS integration requires extra licensing/engineering fees?

Sanjay: KMS short answer: integration included but depends on customer HSM/connector. If ACME wants HSM-backed keys on their side we typically run an integration sprint (2–3 engineer days). Engineering fee estimate: $8k one‑time. If they use customer-managed KMS with standard API endpoints, we don't charge extra for the control-plane side.

Sanjay: sample config we typically share with customers:
````
kms:
  provider: customer-kms
  endpoint: https://kms.acme.internal
  key_id: projects/acme/locations/global/keyRings/rk/cryptoKeys/ck
````

Anya: so to summarize for ACME pitch — Marc, can you confirm recommended internal approval path and who needs to approve if we pick Option 2 (50% credit across months 2–3, amortized)?

Marc: for Option 2 we need: 
1) Deal desk approved pricing memo (I can draft)
2) VP Sales sign-off (discount >25%)
3) Finance OK on revenue recognition approach (Lucy)
4) Legal to include credit/recoup language (Emma)

Lucy: finance greenlight conditions: credits amortized across invoices are ok. Upfront waive is not ideal from rev recognition POV. If we do a 50% credit, we need a signed PO for at least the first 3 months and the credit schedule in SOW.

Emma: I'll draft a two‑paragraph addendum template we can reuse: (a) credit schedule, (b) recoup clause if customer terminates within first 6 months, (c) KMS/residency obligations.

Anya: perfect. @cthomas_acme i'll summarize options and send a short term-sheet today. Which of the three options would your team prefer to see first?

cthomas_acme: Option 2 looks best to start. If we can get a simple 3‑month PO and the credit applied without a 12mo lock, that's ideal. Also want KMS engineering scope spelled out.

Marc: actionable next steps:
- Anya: get formal PO stub from ACME (3 months) + preferred option confirmed.
- Marc: I'll draft the pricing memo for deal desk with numbers and approval path.
- Lucy: please confirm revenue treatment once memo is ready.
- Emma: will prepare the addendum template for credits and recoup.

deploy-bot: reminder — please attach the proposed SOW and PO draft to the thread for tracking (use the sales-docs template).

Anya: will attach docs in 1h. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
